## 📊 Evaluation Rubric Checklist
- [ ] **RDBMS & Schema Normalization**: 3NF schema, primary/foreign keys, indexes, check constraints.
- [ ] **Transactional Concurrency**: Concurrency-safe seat quotas, no over-allotment race conditions.
- [ ] **Security & RBAC**: Dual-mode JWT/OTP auth, role guards, password hashing, DPDP Act compliance.
- [ ] **Full-Stack Implementation**: Next.js 14 frontend, NestJS modular monolith API.
- [ ] **Automated Testing & CI**: Unit tests passing, GitHub Actions CI operational.
- [ ] **Code Quality & Documentation**: Clean architecture, ER diagrams, setup documentation.

## 📝 Observations & Recommendations
Please share any architectural recommendations, edge cases to handle, or suggestions for subsequent project phases.
